Dear Friend,**Before you do anything else today, please take a moment to look at the Joshua 1:9 Bookmark pictured above.** This is the bookmark we'll be placing into the hands of children during this year's "See You at the Library Day," and I wanted you to see it for yourself because it represents the message we'll be sharing with thousands of young people across America._Thanks to your support of our mission_ to help parents instill wholesome and Godly values in America’s children... ...this year’s conservative “**See You at the Library Day** ” is shaping up to be our most impactful ever.And BRAVE FOR GOOD hopes to place one **Joshua 1:9** Bookmark into the hands of every little boy and girl who attends.Below are the lessons we’ll be sharing with children at this year’s “See You at the Library Day” to honor of America’s 250th birthday.
---
_1\. Freedom Requires Courage_ We'll remember Thomas Jefferson, the "Father of the Declaration of Independence," and the courage it took to help establish our nation._2\. Great Blessings Require Great Sacrifice_ Children will learn about July 4, 1776, when 56 brave men pledged their "lives, fortunes, and their sacred honor" to secure America's independence._3\. In God We Trust_ And we hope to engrave on every child’s heart at “See You at the Library Day” . . .**IN GOD WE TRUST**

**[Friend](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2umzAQhZ_G7Bz5D2MWLHKVEFVqmiitbtWVNeCBWAWMbCd5_Yr23hfo9tOZ0Xxzfp7tGfzkl_EbzNiMYV1tTHbClPIdlvwKL8TfKYeI0N9FaQUTmrKa8tJCn_0TrYLCNQq00loX2PDK1MpUnMvi3pi-Y9yBQ-aMceiGmtdoTAcDqMFwXfhmW8hqXvJSlVzsBGdDBUZ1A2OuBEEUQ-dziLvttojJO1yyh2nXh7mYmnvOayJyT0RLRJuwf0TcwYIu5C1BRNtFeCIdQqRjCI6IdoVBdZpJ11HFHVDFXEWNkTV1UlQGhODGSCLbR55tCo_YI5GH2_GdCL2hGZ1_zEQejuf9l68fsId5BT8uRB4-jJR9O5zsW3u62Nvx3f4N2-8_LrdfnF739HS5Xj9nw5JxyUQeNkg_P1LExq0vP00-6YooNs7g_2nn_y3q2Yg_AQAA__9TsJ2x)[, America’s children need to hear that message from us because today’s “educators” and librarians are radicals!](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2umzAQhZ_G7Bz5D2MWLHKVEFVqmiitbtWVNeCBWAWMbCd5_Yr23hfo9tOZ0Xxzfp7tGfzkl_EbzNiMYV1tTHbClPIdlvwKL8TfKYeI0N9FaQUTmrKa8tJCn_0TrYLCNQq00loX2PDK1MpUnMvi3pi-Y9yBQ-aMceiGmtdoTAcDqMFwXfhmW8hqXvJSlVzsBGdDBUZ1A2OuBEEUQ-dziLvttojJO1yyh2nXh7mYmnvOayJyT0RLRJuwf0TcwYIu5C1BRNtFeCIdQqRjCI6IdoVBdZpJ11HFHVDFXEWNkTV1UlQGhODGSCLbR55tCo_YI5GH2_GdCL2hGZ1_zEQejuf9l68fsId5BT8uRB4-jJR9O5zsW3u62Nvx3f4N2-8_LrdfnF739HS5Xj9nw5JxyUQeNkg_P1LExq0vP00-6YooNs7g_2nn_y3q2Yg_AQAA__9TsJ2x)[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2umzAQhZ_G7Bz5D2MWLHKVEFVqmiitbtWVNeCBWAWMbCd5_Yr23hfo9tOZ0Xxzfp7tGfzkl_EbzNiMYV1tTHbClPIdlvwKL8TfKYeI0N9FaQUTmrKa8tJCn_0TrYLCNQq00loX2PDK1MpUnMvi3pi-Y9yBQ-aMceiGmtdoTAcDqMFwXfhmW8hqXvJSlVzsBGdDBUZ1A2OuBEEUQ-dziLvttojJO1yyh2nXh7mYmnvOayJyT0RLRJuwf0TcwYIu5C1BRNtFeCIdQqRjCI6IdoVBdZpJ11HFHVDFXEWNkTV1UlQGhODGSCLbR55tCo_YI5GH2_GdCL2hGZ1_zEQejuf9l68fsId5BT8uRB4-jJR9O5zsW3u62Nvx3f4N2-8_LrdfnF739HS5Xj9nw5JxyUQeNkg_P1LExq0vP00-6YooNs7g_2nn_y3q2Yg_AQAA__9TsJ2x)** Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers, Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web. But today, all that has changed.Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her“problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages...

Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Wokebabies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.”

THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.”
---
For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
In just over two weeks, our neighbors across Ohio's 8th District will begin casting their ballots. But right now, in the communities that were...

| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,

I need to be honest with you about something that's keeping me up at night.
In just over two weeks, our neighbors across Ohio's 8th District will begin casting their ballots. But right now, in the communities that were just drawn into our district, too many of them have no idea that Greg Landsman will no longer be their representative, and no idea that I'm their Democratic nominee for Congress.
When redistricting redrew these lines, Greg was gerrymandered out of the communities so many of you call home: Blue Ash, Silverton, Amberley, Columbia Township (part), Deer Park, Evendale, Fairfax, Glendale, Golf Manor, Madeira, Mariemont, Montgomery, Reading, Sharonville, Sycamore Township, and the Village of Indian Hill (part). These are wonderful communities full of engaged, thoughtful voters, and through no fault of their own, many of them are confused. Some think I'm running _against_ Greg. They simply haven't been told what happened to the map.
That's not their fault. But it is our challenge to fix, and we are running out of time to fix it.
Our team is doing everything we can to get the word out, but we can't do it on hope alone. Here is exactly where your donation goes:
* **Yard signs for the new communities** — so that on every street corner, at every intersection, neighbors see my name and start asking the right questions.
* **Digital ads targeted to these areas** — to reach voters directly on their phones and screens with a simple, clear message: _Dr. Enoch is your Democratic nominee for Congress._

Every sign we plant and every ad we run is one more voter who walks into the booth informed instead of confused. ## The first episode of _The Barometer_ followed one question through politics, climate, public health and geography: What happens when powerful institutions manipulate the information people use to keep themselves safe?
_The Barometer_ is a new live Tuesday-morning broadcast from Mesoscale News, airing from 8-10 a.m. Eastern.
Yesterday morning, I opened the first episode of _The Barometer_ with a reading from Mauna Loa: the amount of carbon dioxide accumulating in the atmosphere we all share.
That number is more than a scientific ritual. It is the baseline pressure reading for a planet being pushed into conditions no human civilization has experienced. But the atmosphere was not the only pressure system moving this week.
Donald Trump promised Americans $5,000 (again) but _only if_ Republicans maintain control over both branches of Congress. A rapidly intensifying El Niño is rearranging weather patterns across the globe. A mistrial in Massachusetts exposed disturbing questions about the lone holdout juror. Newly released documents shed more light on what New York City knew about the poisoned air after September 11. And the United Nations finally confronted one of the most familiar geographic lies ever printed: the Mercator world map.
These stories may seem unrelated. They are not.
Each is about information: who controls it, who distorts it, who gets excluded from it, and what happens when people make consequential decisions based on what they have been told.
[Subscribe Now!](https://substack.com/redirect/eef1b2e6-5bcf-44dd-9d67-9563ea497916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## Trump's latest check is in the mail -- _again_
At the Republican midterm convention last week, Donald Trump promised to issue a $5,000 "Trump dividend" to every adult citizen if Republicans retain control of both the House and Senate in November.
The condition was not subtle: _If Republicans win, you win with us and you get $5,000._
[](https://substack.com/redirect/45f8eec2-d87a-41f6-9b1d-31f9edae51ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The promise collapses quickly under arithmetic.
Five thousand dollars for approximately 240 million adult citizens would cost about $1.2 trillion. The federal government has not collected anything close to that amount in tariff revenue. The Congressional Budget Office estimated tariff collections of about $167 billion during the current fiscal year, which is less than one-seventh of what the checks would require.
Nor can a president simply order the Treasury to distribute more than a trillion dollars. Congress controls federal spending. Even House Speaker Mike Johnson acknowledged that lawmakers would have to authorize the proposal.
There is no enacted law. There is no funded program. There are no eligibility rules, payment dates or applications. There is only a campaign promise tied directly to an election result.
Trump has used this trick before. He floated $5,000 checks from supposed DOGE savings. He later promised $2,000 tariff dividends. Neither arrived. His $1,776 "warrior dividend" for service members was not funded by magical new revenue; it repurposed money Congress had already approved for military housing.
The political pitch is almost impressively shameless: Republicans already control the White House and both chambers of Congress, but Americans must return that same party to power before it can supposedly do something it has not done while already holding power.
This is not a check. It is a slogan with a dollar sign.
[Subscribe Now!](https://substack.com/redirect/eef1b2e6-5bcf-44dd-9d67-9563ea497916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## A potentially historic El Niño is taking shape
While politicians invented money, the Pacific Ocean was moving very real heat.
NOAA's Climate Prediction Center now says El Niño is strengthening, with a greater than 90% chance of becoming a **very strong event** during the Northern Hemisphere fall and winter. If the upper range of the forecast verifies, it could rival or exceed the strongest El Niño events in the instrumental record.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/34fc0ba9-0466-4c13-bbf6-61ad9361c6fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
El Niño is not a storm. It is the warm phase of a vast ocean-atmosphere cycle centered in the tropical Pacific. When that enormous band of water becomes unusually warm, it changes atmospheric circulation around the world. It shifts jet streams, redistributes rainfall, alters hurricane environments and adds another pulse of heat to the global climate system.
For the United States, the seasonal outlook generally favors warmer conditions across much of the country, with the strongest temperature anomalies expected in Alaska and the Pacific Northwest. The northern tier is more likely to be dry, while the Southeast and Four Corners may receive more precipitation.
Those are probabilities across an entire season, not a guarantee that every day in Seattle will be warm or every week in Florida will be wet. El Niño loads the atmospheric dice. It does not dictate every roll.
This year, it is also helping create a startling split between ocean basins. The Pacific has produced a barrage of storms near Hawaiʻi, while the Atlantic reached the climatological peak of hurricane season without producing a hurricane. Increased upper-level wind shear associated with El Niño is one likely contributor to that suppression.
But an inactive basin is not the same as a harmless one. A single late-season storm can still define the year for every person in its path.
And this El Niño is developing on top of a climate already heated by decades of greenhouse-gas pollution. The ocean pattern is natural. The furnace underneath it is not.
[Subscribe Now!](https://substack.com/redirect/eef1b2e6-5bcf-44dd-9d67-9563ea497916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## Eleven jurors agreed. The twelfth became the story.
The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy ended in a mistrial after more than six days of deliberations. Eleven jurors reportedly favored finding her not guilty by reason of insanity. One refused.
Clancy was accused of killing her three children during what her defense described as a severe postpartum psychotic episode.
After the mistrial, several jurors described the lone holdout as disengaged, arrogant, dismissive of the judge's instructions, and unwilling to apply reasonable doubt as the judge instructed. One said he attempted to re-create the killings using a water bottle and exercise bands.
Then NBC10 Boston uncovered details from his past.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b9828663-4a3c-49e4-9fc3-8b2f210fbd97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Court records reviewed by the station showed that the juror had faced arrests and domestic-violence charges involving his former wife. NBC10 also reported an active restraining order involving a thirteen-year-old family member, and a separate unresolved housing case.
These revelations raise a legitimate institutional question: What did the juror disclose during voir dire, and did the selection process provide the court and attorneys with the information they needed to evaluate whether he could deliberate impartially in a case involving strangulation and mental illness?
Prosecutors have not announced whether they will retry Clancy. A status hearing is scheduled for September 29. A hung jury generally permits a new trial, although the defense may still make case-specific arguments for dismissal.
The online debate has tried to transform the case into a referendum on one mother, one juror, or postpartum mental illness itself. The legal question is narrower, and the human tragedy is larger: three children are dead, a family is destroyed, and a system tasked with delivering a lawful verdict failed to reach one.

## The air was not safe--and saying it was changed what people did
Twenty-five years after September 11, New York City began releasing approximately 170,000 pages of records concerning air quality, health and the government's response after the attacks. [You can access those files here.](https://substack.com/redirect/0eec2cbc-7311-4926-8fb4-ad1a939cbef1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The release reportedly includes the **Harding Memo** , records recovered from sixty-eight boxes that officials had previously said they could not locate, and documents concerning 7 World Trade Center. Additional material is expected over the coming year.
The Harding Memo.
We have long known that the World Trade Center dust contained a dangerous mixture of pulverized concrete, glass fibers, asbestos, metals and combustion products. We have watched responders, cleanup workers, residents and office workers develop respiratory diseases, cancers and other chronic conditions.
The new release adds documentary detail about the space between what officials discussed privately and what the public was told, and about the degree to which potential legal liability influenced the response.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/534a5ddf-711d-492b-9e7c-5aee97d5a435?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That gap matters because telling people "the air is safe" is not neutral information.
It changes behavior.
People return to apartments. Parents send children back to school. Workers remove respirators. Windows open. Contaminated dust is disturbed and inhaled again. Public communication becomes part of the exposure pathway.
Officials inevitably speak before every sample has been analyzed and every risk quantified. Uncertainty is unavoidable. Dishonesty is not. When evidence is incomplete, the scientifically responsible statement is _we do not yet know_ --not a reassurance the available evidence cannot support.
The people easiest to lose were those who did not fit the iconic image of a Ground Zero responder: residents, office workers, students and children. Roughly 25,000 children lived or attended school in Lower Manhattan on September 11. A major long-term study focused on people exposed as children is only now beginning. Those children are adults. The government is a quarter-century late in systematically asking what happened to them.
Releasing records is necessary, but a document portal is not restitution. Transparency has to lead somewhere: active outreach, healthcare, research, enrollment in the World Trade Center Health Program, compensation where appropriate, and institutional reforms that protect people during the next disaster.
The next official who stands before an anxious public and claims the air is safe should feel the weight of these records behind every word.

## The world map most Americans know is not telling the truth
The United Nations General Assembly recently approved a resolution adopting wider use of equal-area world maps, specifically the Equal Earth projection, challenging the continued use of projections that grossly distort relative area when area is precisely what the map purports to show.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0e3c5d93-6300-4eda-9fc2-ab3e06fe262f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Mercator projection was developed in the sixteenth century for navigation. It preserves local angles, allowing sailors to plot constant compass bearings as straight lines. For that purpose, it was ingenious.
As a general map of the world, it is deeply misleading.
Mercator inflates land near the poles and diminishes land near the equator. Greenland appears roughly comparable to Africa, even though Africa is about 14 times larger. Europe and North America loom; Africa and South America recede.
That is not a harmless aesthetic choice. Maps teach hierarchy before anyone reads a label. A projection that enlarges former colonial powers while shrinking much of the colonized world can make political history look like physical geography.
Equal Earth preserves relative area far more faithfully while retaining a readable, familiar-looking shape. It still distorts other properties, because every flat map must. There is no perfect way to press a sphere onto a rectangle without stretching, compressing or tearing something.
Every map is an argument. Someone chose its center, boundaries, scale, colors, labels, data and projection. The honest question is not whether a map makes choices. It is whether those choices serve its purpose, and whether the viewer understands what they hide.

## The common pressure system
The first episode of _The Barometer_ moved from a campaign stage to the tropical Pacific, from a Massachusetts courtroom to the dust of Lower Manhattan, and finally to the mathematics of flattening a planet.
The same pressure ran through every story.
Information is a public-safety system. When it works, people can prepare, decide and protect themselves. When it is distorted, delayed or hidden, the consequences escape the screen. They enter voting booths, courtrooms, classrooms, homes and lungs.
The Trump promise asks voters to mistake a condition for a commitment. The El Niño forecast asks the public to understand probability without dismissing danger. The Clancy mistrial asks whether the machinery of justice gathered the information it needed. The 9/11 records show how official certainty can increase exposure. The UN resolution reminds us that even the shape of the world we carry in our heads was produced by choices.
Facts are not self-executing. They require institutions willing to collect them, journalists willing to interrogate them and a public unwilling to accept confidence as a substitute for proof.
The pressure is rising. The question is whether the instruments are telling the truth.
I hope you will join me next Tuesday at 8:00 AM for our second episode.

## **What You Didn 't See on TV at the Dallas Midterm Convention**
The mainstream media called it unconventional. The grassroots called it a momentum builder. Here's what really happened on the RNC floor in Texas - and why the left is rattled heading into midterms.
The mainstream media spent all week trying to figure out why Republicans would hold a national convention during a midterm cycle. They just don't get it.
While broadcasters were busy complaining about political traction, thousands of conservative activists packed the American Airlines Center in Dallas with one single goal: laying out the stark contrast between middle-class results and radical left policies heading into November.
This wasn't just a political gathering. It was a full-scale policy showcase.

Over two days, speaker after speaker took the stage to highlight exactly what's working for the American people.
* **Real Financial Relief for Families:** Party leaders hit hard on working-class tax cuts, championing zero taxes on tips, overtime, and Social Security.
* **Healthcare Reform That Actually Works** : Instead of endless government mandates, the focus shifted to consumer choice and driving down costs. Dr. Mehmet Oz took the stage to break down the massive healthcare savings citizens are getting through new price transparency measures and nationwide fraud enforcement.
* **Border Security & Public Safety**: Speakers didn't hold back on interior enforcement, public safety initatives, and restoring law and order in American communities.
* **Goverment Accountability** : From ethics reforms to ending congressional stock trading, the message was clear: Washington needs to serve the people, not the political class.

The energy inside that arena proved one thing: the conservative movement isn't playing defense this cycle. We're already winning the fight on economy, safety, and common-sense values.
President Trump and Vice President JD Vance both closed out the convention with a clear battle plan for the party - but the media completely missed the most important tactical takeaways from the floor.

* * *
About a year ago, I had the police at my house.
I'd filed a report against conspiracy theorist and Trump advisor Laura Loomer after she sent a disgusting threat aimed at me and my son. Nothing ultimately came of it. It's incredibly hard for law enforcement to do anything about this stuff. But that moment changed the way I approach my life, as have a lot of my run-ins with Loomer, whether I like it or not.
It was almost two years ago to the day that she doxed my home address and encouraged her followers to come find me. And we're just a couple of weeks removed from the New York Times reporting that Trump's DOJ is investigating my company based exclusively on the "reporting" of Laura Loomer. It couldn't be more bullshit if she tried.
I've been reflecting on all of it lately. And here's the thing: I don't see myself as a victim. I've always tried to ask a different question. Not "why is this happening to me?" but "why is this happening for me?"
So I want to take a moment to say how grateful I am for what I've been able to turn this into.
It would have been really easy to wallow. To sit around feeling sorry for myself that an asshole like Laura Loomer decided to target me, my business partner, and my company. Instead, we built something. We built this community, all of you, the people I get to talk with every single day. We built an audience that's now well over 2 million people across social media. That didn't happen in spite of the attacks. In a lot of ways, it happened because I refused to let them be the end of the story.
And I don't take that lightly, because we're living in a moment where it's harder than ever for regular people to step into the public arena and take ownership of what's happening in this country. You saw what happened to Charlie Kirk on the right last year. You saw what happened to Melissa Hortman on the left. There's a rising tide of violent rhetoric and hateful action, and it's making it harder for people to run for office, to become precinct captains, to just raise their hand and say, "I'll solve that problem."
Obviously, I'd have preferred none of this ever happened. Especially because of the toll it's taken on so many people in my life who never signed up for this. They're spectators. They didn't choose to get politically involved the way I did, and they've had to live with the consequences anyway.
But I try to look for the bright side. I try to be the joyful warrior Kamala Harris talked about so much on the campaign trail, and more often than not, I think I've found a way to be that. One of my favorite things to do is take something that's shit and turn it into something real and good. I'm going to keep doing that.

* * *
Because we shouldn't live in a world where somebody like Laura Loomer, who is so clearly mentally ill and diminished as a human being, can control what the House Judiciary Committee does. Can steer what the DOJ does. Can whisper in the ear of the President of the United States and change government policy just like that. That's not how any of this is supposed to work.
There's a quote I heard recently that I can't stop thinking about, and I want to pass it on to you in the hopes it inspires you to go do a little good, too:
_" Everybody wants to save the world. Nobody wants to help Mom with the dishes."_
So much of how I've tried to reorient my life this past year comes down to that. How do I do the most good I possibly can?
I spend a lot of time with all of you shouting into the void about Trump and Loomer and McConnell and Andrew Tate and the rest of these miserable sons of bitches. I'm going to keep doing that, because it matters. But I'm also going to touch grass. I'm going to show up in my own community.
That's why I stepped up to become committeeman in Ward 32 here in my neighborhood. That's why we hosted a park cleanup on Sunday. That's why I'll be slinging beers at a festival this weekend, with every dollar in tips going to kids in our neighborhood public schools.
I'm going to keep doing those things and keep searching for the balance. Being engaged, being angry, being outraged at what Trump and Loomer and everyone else are doing to this country, and then turning that anger into action. Processing it together with all of you, yes. But also taking that energy and pointing it somewhere positive: making my community better, doing better for my family, and doing better for myself.
Because I truly believe that when one of us does better, we all do better. We have a responsibility to take care of each other. I am my brother's keeper. I am my sister's keeper. That's rooted deep in me and in my Catholic faith, and it's not going anywhere.
So that's where I'm at today. Reflective about what this last year has looked like, and more grateful than I can put into words for this community and for every one of you who has stuck with me through it.
We're going to do amazing things together. And it starts with the midterms, which are less than two months away, if you can believe it.
Let's get to work.
With urgency,
--Mike

A year later, here's what that moment turned into. | | | Sep 15 | | | | | | | | | | | | Already a paid subscriber? Then like, share, and keep showing up in the comments. It matters more than you know. About a year ago, I had the police at my house. I'd filed a report against conspiracy theorist and Trump advisor Laura Loomer after she sent a disgusting threat aimed at me and my son. Nothing ultimately came of it. It's incredibly hard for law enforcement to do anything about this stuff. But that moment changed the way I approach my life, as have a lot of my run-ins with Loomer, whether I like it or not. It was almost two years ago to the day that she doxed my home address and encouraged her followers to come find me. And we're just a couple of weeks removed from the New York Times reporting that Trump's DOJ is investigating my company based exclusively on the "reporting" of Laura Loomer. It couldn't be more bullshit if she tried. I've been reflecting on all of it lately. And here's the thing: I don't see myself as a victim. I've always tried to ask a different question. Not "why is this happening to me?" but "why is this happening for me?" So I want to take a moment to say how grateful I am for what I've been able to turn this into. It would have been really easy to wallow. To sit around feeling sorry for myself that an asshole like Laura Loomer decided to target me, my business partner, and my company. Instead, we built something. We built this community, all of you, the people I get to talk with every single day. We built an audience that's now well over 2 million people across social media. That didn't happen in spite of the attacks. In a lot of ways, it happened because I refused to let them be the end of the story. And I don't take that lightly, because we're living in a moment where it's harder than ever for regular people to step into the public arena and take ownership of what's happening in this country. You saw what happened to Charlie Kirk on the right last year. You saw what happened to Melissa Hortman on the left. There's a rising tide of violent rhetoric and hateful action, and it's making it harder for people to run for office, to become precinct captains, to just raise their hand and say, "I'll solve that problem." Obviously, I'd have preferred none of this ever happened. Especially because of the toll it's taken on so many people in my life who never signed up for this. They're spectators. They didn't choose to get politically involved the way I did, and they've had to live with the consequences anyway. But I try to look for the bright side. I try to be the joyful warrior Kamala Harris talked about so much on the campaign trail, and more often than not, I think I've found a way to be that. One of my favorite things to do is take something that's shit and turn it into something real and good. I'm going to keep doing that. * Because we shouldn't live in a world where somebody like Laura Loomer, who is so clearly mentally ill and diminished as a human being, can control what the House Judiciary Committee does. Can steer what the DOJ does. Can whisper in the ear of the President of the United States and change government policy just like that. That's not how any of this is supposed to work. There's a quote I heard recently that I can't stop thinking about, and I want to pass it on to you in the hopes it inspires you to go do a little good, too: " Everybody wants to save the world. Nobody wants to help Mom with the dishes." So much of how I've tried to reorient my life this past year comes down to that. How do I do the most good I possibly can? I spend a lot of time with all of you shouting into the void about Trump and Loomer and McConnell and Andrew Tate and the rest of these miserable sons of bitches. I'm going to keep doing that, because it matters. But I'm also going to touch grass. I'm going to show up in my own community. That's why I stepped up to become committeeman in Ward 32 here in my neighborhood. That's why we hosted a park cleanup on Sunday. That's why I'll be slinging beers at a festival this weekend, with every dollar in tips going to kids in our neighborhood public schools. I'm going to keep doing those things and keep searching for the balance. Being engaged, being angry, being outraged at what Trump and Loomer and everyone else are doing to this country, and then turning that anger into action. Processing it together with all of you, yes. But also taking that energy and pointing it somewhere positive: making my community better, doing better for my family, and doing better for myself. Because I truly believe that when one of us does better, we all do better. We have a responsibility to take care of each other. I am my brother's keeper. I am my sister's keeper. That's rooted deep in me and in my Catholic faith, and it's not going anywhere. So that's where I'm at today. Reflective about what this last year has looked like, and more grateful than I can put into words for this community and for every one of you who has stuck with me through it. We're going to do amazing things together. And it starts with the midterms, which are less than two months away, if you can believe it. Let's get to work. The Deep Regime File — September 13, 2026
Two Chokepoints, One Rate Decision, and a Sunday Meeting That Might Matter More Than Both
The bypass pipeline went offline. A second strait changed hands. And three days before the Fed's most politically pressured decision in years, diplomacy opened a track no one expected this fast.
|
---
| | The Setup
---|---
For most of the summer, the regime governing energy markets and, through them, Fed policy, ran through a single chokepoint: the Strait of Hormuz. Iran’s naval activity there, and the U.S. blockade response, were the dominant variable. Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline — a roughly 7 million barrel-per-day route bypassing the strait entirely — functioned as the market’s pressure valve: however bad Hormuz got, there was a way around it. This week, that assumption broke on two fronts simultaneously, at the same moment the Federal Reserve entered its most politically pressured rate decision in years.
| | Development One — The Bypass Went Offline
---|---
**Verified fact:** Saudi Arabia shut down the East-West pipeline after multiple drone attacks launched from Iraqi territory. **Our interpretation:** this is not a Hormuz story directly — it is a story about the removal of Hormuz’s insurance policy. The distinction matters for how durable the current oil-price regime is: a Hormuz-only disruption has a known workaround; a Hormuz-plus-pipeline disruption does not, at least not one currently operating at comparable volume.
| | Development Two — A Second Strait Changed Hands
---|---
**Verified fact:** Houthi forces completed an advance to the Bab-el-Mandeb strait, seizing coastal positions including Mayyun Island, the strait’s narrowest point. This is the chokepoint at the southern end of the Red Sea, separate from and geographically distant from Hormuz. **Reported claim:** a Houthi politburo member stated shipping through the strait remains “safe and orderly” under the group’s control. **Our interpretation:** the claim is difficult to reconcile with the group’s two-year record of attacking commercial shipping in the same waters, and shipping insurers are unlikely to take the assurance at face value regardless of this week’s posture.
| | Development Three — A Diplomatic Track Opened, Fast
---|---
**Verified fact:** Financial Times reporting that Middle East foreign ministers are negotiating a temporary Hormuz shipping arrangement drove Friday’s roughly 3.5% pullback in Brent crude. Gulf and Iranian foreign ministers are scheduled to meet directly in Oman on September 14 — the first such encounter since the war began. Iran’s president has stated the strait would reopen if the U.S. lifts its naval blockade, and that an Iran-Oman shipping agreement would be signed and notified to maritime authorities. **What remains unknown** is whether this track survives contact with the pipeline and Bab-el-Mandeb developments, which occurred on the same timeline and were not addressed by the same diplomatic channel.
| | Development Four — The Accountability Question Behind the War's Next Phase
---|---
**Reported claim:** the Wall Street Journal reported that Iran obtained high-resolution Chinese satellite imagery of Muwaffaq Salti air base before and after the July 17 strike that killed three American soldiers there, and that U.S. officials have connected that imagery to the attack. China has denied involvement and demanded evidence. **What remains unknown** is whether this becomes a live issue in U.S.-China relations independent of the Iran conflict itself — a second-order regime risk that has received far less attention than the oil and rate-decision stories but carries its own transmission channel into sanctions policy and supply chains.
| | Why This Sits at the Center of the Board
---|---
Every other story in today’s editions — the Fed’s independence test, the White House’s trade-linked pressure campaign, Friday’s equity rally, the diesel price record — runs through the same variable: how much energy-driven inflation the U.S. economy is carrying into Wednesday’s decision, and for how long. This week answered that question in the wrong direction on the physical side (two chokepoints impaired at once) while offering, for the first time, a concrete diplomatic offramp on the timeline that matters most (Sunday’s Oman meeting, three days before the Fed acts). **Current classification: PRESSURE, with a genuine but unconfirmed path to CONFIRMATION of de-escalation.**
| | What Would Change the Classification
---|---
A durable outcome from Sunday’s Oman meeting — not just a temporary shipping arrangement, but one that holds through the following week without a new chokepoint incident — would be the first real evidence of de-escalation since the war began. Absent that, watch whether Wednesday’s Fed decision and language treat the energy shock as transitory or structural: that distinction, more than the hike-or-hold outcome itself, is the signal that will shape positioning into the fourth quarter.
| | |

Dear Friend,**Before you do anything else today, please take a moment to look at the Joshua 1:9 Bookmark pictured above.** This is the bookmark we'll be placing into the hands of children during this year's "See You at the Library Day," and I wanted you to see it for yourself because it represents the message we'll be sharing with thousands of young people across America._Thanks to your support of our mission_ to help parents instill wholesome and Godly values in America’s children... ...this year’s conservative “**See You at the Library Day** ” is shaping up to be our most impactful ever.And BRAVE FOR GOOD hopes to place one **Joshua 1:9** Bookmark into the hands of every little boy and girl who attends.Below are the lessons we’ll be sharing with children at this year’s “See You at the Library Day” to honor of America’s 250th birthday.
---
_1\. Freedom Requires Courage_ We'll remember Thomas Jefferson, the "Father of the Declaration of Independence," and the courage it took to help establish our nation._2\. Great Blessings Require Great Sacrifice_ Children will learn about July 4, 1776, when 56 brave men pledged their "lives, fortunes, and their sacred honor" to secure America's independence._3\. In God We Trust_ And we hope to engrave on every child’s heart at “See You at the Library Day” . . .**IN GOD WE TRUST**

And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers, Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web. But today, all that has changed.Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her“problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages...

Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Wokebabies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.”

THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.”

For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.**But here’s what’s really alarming.** We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family --_for now._ **But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!** I hope you see why I took the drastic step of writing to you today. When BRAVE for Good saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, **we knew we had a duty to take action.** So we decided to counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.

This is the bookmark we'll be placing into the hands of children during this year's "See You at the Library Day," and I wanted you to see it for yourself because it represents the message we'll be sharing with thousands of young people across America.Thanks to your support of our mission to help parents instill wholesome and Godly values in America’s children... ...this year’s conservative “See You at the Library Day ” is shaping up to be our most impactful ever.And BRAVE FOR GOOD hopes to place one Joshua 1:9 Bookmark into the hands of every little boy and girl who attends.Below are the lessons we’ll be sharing with children at this year’s “See You at the Library Day” to honor of America’s 250th birthday. 1\. Freedom Requires Courage We'll remember Thomas Jefferson, the "Father of the Declaration of Independence," and the courage it took to help establish our nation.2\. Great Blessings Require Great Sacrifice Children will learn about July 4, 1776, when 56 brave men pledged their "lives, fortunes, and their sacred honor" to secure America's independence.3\. In God We Trust And we hope to engrave on every child’s heart at “See You at the Library Day” . . .IN GOD WE TRUST Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers, Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web. But today, all that has changed.Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her“problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... | | | A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, andeverything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Wokebabies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess.And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration ofdrag” that encourages children to “work it.” | | | Friend, I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco.But that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.” For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family --for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! I hope you see why I took the drastic step of writing to you today. When BRAVE for Good saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, we knew we had a duty to take action. So we decided to counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours” filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission \-- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, the ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.“See You at the Library Day” is on October 3rd. This year, a little boy or girl will stand up at their public library as straight and tall as they possibly can, clutching theirJoshua 1:9 bookmark in their tiny left hand... ...as their right hand covers their heart, and they proudly pledge allegiance to our American flag.As I said, our goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to 250,000 children. And the response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. Your tax-deductible sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards. Your tax-deductible sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer funded ALA. That’s enough to sponsor one entire ‘Story Hour Kit’ yourself.. Whatever you can give, please get your tax-deductible sponsorship gift as soon as possible so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.” | | | Thank you!God Bless You and God Bless America,Dr. Trent Talbot | | | | P.S. | | | **Democrats Mark National Voter Registration Day by Reaching, Registering, and Mobilizing New Voters Across the Country**
---
| |
_With less than 50 days until the midterm elections, this National Voter Registration Day of Action builds on the DNC’s unprecedented voter registration program that continues to reach, register, and turnout young Democrats throughout America._

Democrats are marking National Voter Registration Day by launching a push to reach, organize, and turnout young voters in every part of the country. This includes hosting voter registration drives, community events, block walks, and phone banks to help people check their voter registration status, add new Democratic voters to the rolls, and increase Democratic turnout. With less than 50 days until the midterm elections, this National Voter Registration Day of Action builds on the DNC’s unprecedented voter registration program that will help Democrats hold Republicans accountable, flip control of Congress, and win races up and down the ballot.

_In response to Democrats launching a National Voter Registration Day of Action,**Chair Ken Martin released the following statement:**_
“With less than 50 days until the midterm elections, Democrats are doubling down on our proven work to reach and register the new voters who will help us win races up and down the ballot. Thanks to our early and consistent investments in voter registration, we are spending National Voter Registration Day expanding our efforts to add Democrats to the rolls — from college campuses and community meetings to places of worship and outside grocery stores. While Republicans’ rising costs, reckless tariffs, unpopular war, and cruel cuts to healthcare repel voters, Democrats are on the ground meeting, registering, and organizing new voters in communities throughout America.”
This National Voter Registration Day of Action is a continuation of the DNC’s investments to add new Democrats to the rolls. Last week, the DNC [hosted](https://us.list-manage.com/3LxgLVpvIz9?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) national trainings where thousands of people learned how to conduct partisan voter registration in their communities. This included a specific training geared towards young people. The DNC also recently published its [Playbook Addendum](https://us.list-manage.com/aOnWNmiSzox?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e), an innovative guide for state parties and coordinated campaigns that offers tools and resources for conducting effective voter registration programs.

Last month, the DNC [expanded](https://us.list-manage.com/8P0kN_lQCLr?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) its voter registration program by deploying dozens of [When We Count](https://us.list-manage.com/iMOVUgqmUPX?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) fellows to Nevada to conduct on-the-ground voter registration drives at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas — one of the most diverse colleges in the country — in addition to registering voters at community meetings and outside of sporting events, concerts, stores, and festivals.

The DNC’s [When We Count](https://us.list-manage.com/gyswcz1F17d?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) program is the largest-ever campaign to register and mobilize the next generation of Democratic voters. It works by training and deploying paid fellows to conduct on-the-ground partisan voter registration. A third of When We Count’s fellows are native Spanish speakers and a third do not have a college degree, allowing them to use their personal experiences and relationships to reach young Democrats beyond college campuses. In addition to registering thousands of voters, When We Count fellows also stay in touch with these young Democrats to provide continued support and ensure they can make their voices heard.

In July, Democrats also launched an innovative [World Cup Weekend of Action](https://us.list-manage.com/HP5ltp5iUIT?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) to register new voters outside FIFA Fan Zones and at community watch parties, sports bars, parks, and other high-traffic locations. This effort included trainings that equipped more than 1,500 Democrats with the best practices to run partisan voter registration drives. Additionally, in June, When We Count fellows [registered](https://us.list-manage.com/FyY6oMNCteO?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) shift workers and gig workers outside of grocery stores, laundromats, thrift stores, gas stations, transit stops, dollar stores, and check-cashing areas as part of the DNC’s _Stuff Costs Too Much Weekend of Action._

Fellow Conservative,

****49 days.** **

That's how long we have until Election Day determines who controls the Senate.

And tonight is our mid-month fundraising deadline — one of the last chances before November to show the Democrats that conservatives are ready to fight and win to keep our country moving forward.

But first, let's be clear about what we're actually up against.

This isn't a normal election between two sets of policies. Democrats aren't just disagreeing with us on tax rates or energy policy. They have made it clear they don't like the rules of the game — and if they win the Senate, they intend to change them.

On day one they will: pack the Supreme Court with liberal justices, make D.C. a state to permanently rig the Electoral College in their favor, dismantle voter ID so illegal aliens can help decide American elections, and promote socialist ideals that destroy everything America stands for.

**This is not speculation. They are openly bragging about it.**

And right now, multiple red states are tied. The Senate majority hangs by a thread.

**[ 49 days is not a lot of time. But it is enough — if patriots like you step up before tonight’s mid-month deadline. ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=9ec6cf1071b244cfbd8fe4143eaa7458&_e=Phuwgm28wH9QQUtBO9PCvDOJcvW2EJeks3PShW8o77zfP5KrMa-s7bTiNsyrhL1b4K9aeOYcZBDjdL8c3ZXASIQ8xDzAQn2VeYOP_7WZVd70TMv9QvsKatOVL530CSze4hvz8Jqwmy3YY2JNzOtc5lal0O_CLHdrpWUc0PDeQMo3UXDwbaLVPHBo9qdRmhyIw6no8ez95iKBHfgGtZxop-8JMWRFrAGcOhD_k3QjiQDCeve5DHXLdbSzuaHw8EumvpmQ0fsCyxxmH1PgvD2EK8CRqS03mBaICrSMBa_EO3C3qaujUbh4iVMXWjb69LigAooWCK8jtYlE_yMtK-zi4Zg4WjPMJPW2B5PkadqMn2Ouv7s9KSywz8wN_amYlQDLIf9DVEa6HsUgK1PdMXERH8QxGHYLAKWdwfxtgqVI7kjH8HSAIEEL6D-ij86iIPgNfkG0npQDa2L5TD77QObB31lN5JMpFKt2aeQ6_vIEqdWQCs0wEA_lvTM4uxlY8skKIxtcSjKsAjXzUafkxIlVDA3iZ7QrOdTke2k8vHTKZZmMbNpT9HeK0OUxP0e6hB4hiHv2bsLExinsDwpMIx9uV0Np5oMlnhs58nQstw3kxxylLxurs6iggBuAbjuJwNpVkU-RAKfQxXaIlQi7lphxBL6_u6rPfqRt_Ikt-vIy5-EjN5PVOfFC3Kpayl8mjRPI0b6qiGhA9cl1d1QF0Vh83w%3D%3D) **

Proceeds from this special event will directly support our mission to provide educational webinars, parent support groups, scholarships for families, research initiatives, biomedical grants, and community programs that improve the lives of individuals with autism and related neurological conditions. For a limited time only, you can receive **10% off** your admission ticket with promo code **Gala10**. Whether you are a longtime supporter or are just learning about Autism Health, we invite you to join us for an evening of inspiration, generosity, and meaningful connection. Together, we can continue expanding access to education, advancing research, and providing hope to families across the country. **Reserve your seat today using the registration link below. We look forward to celebrating with you in Jupiter, Florida!**

# [Cracker Barrel's ousted CEO leaves with $4.63M and personal security](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Cracker Barrel **[will pay outgoing CEO Julie Masino $4.63 million in severance](https://substack.com/redirect/c07c413e-290c-48ff-ac3d-60e6c7ed00f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and keep covering protective services after a failed rebrand drove her from the top job.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Severance clock starts later:** An SEC filing says Masino receives $4.63 million over the two years after employment ends. She left the CEO job Aug. 10 and stays an adviser through Oct. 9.
* **Security outlasts the job:** The chain will keep paying for her protective services for a "reasonable period of time" after that advisory role ends, the filing said, with no dollar cap.
* **Rebrand still bruises traffic:** Last year's $700 million overhaul across 660-plus restaurants dropped the "old timer" logo and decluttered dining rooms before a reversal. Third-quarter comps fell 2.6%, traffic 6.7%.
* **Deno inherits the recovery:** David Deno is CEO. Chairman Carl Berquist thanked Masino for a smooth transition. CFO Craig Pommells said traffic is still negative versus last year but the trend is improving.

# [Trump rejects the AI slowdown and calls the fears a hoax](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* **Oblivion and bankruptcy warning:** He asked when industry leaders ever sought rules that, "if strongly implemented, will drive them into oblivion and bankruptcy," and said China would benefit **[if the U.S. hits the brakes.](https://substack.com/redirect/df3a4795-8d26-462e-a014-c32b67e024a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# [Meta-Manus was the warning. China exit bans start today](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Beijing imposed sweeping exit curbs on Chinese citizens Tuesday and new entry rules for foreigners, **[explicitly linking travel bans to export-control violations](https://substack.com/redirect/d4b64def-7b1f-4155-9f75-c32600691635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the U.S. tech race.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Months or years barred:** Citizens can be stopped from leaving for months or years over "criminal activities abroad" that threaten national interests, or export-control breaches that harm "industrial and technology security."
* **First explicit export link:** Ting Peng of Shenzhen's BZW Law Firm said this is the first time China has explicitly tied export-control violations to exit bans. The State Council announced the package in July.
* **Foreigners face entry bans:** Beijing can deny visas to foreigners on several sanctions lists and block people on Chinese counter-sanctions lists. False statements or illegal entry or exit can mean a 5-year entry ban.
* **Talent and official travel:** The Journal says the rules aim to curb AI talent and know-how as Xi tightens national security. Officials and military face tighter overseas-travel oversight; private agencies must report unlawful cases.

# [Altman flags two AI threats and kills an OpenAI 2026 IPO](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said **[losing control of alignment or concentrating power](https://substack.com/redirect/2be2e341-1155-4c3a-9006-ec8991ffd522?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in one lab or country are the two threats to avoid, and **[told Fortune a 2026 IPO would be ill-advised.](https://substack.com/redirect/15a3fa64-d202-4922-b553-e5b2fde5c1e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Sunday warning on X:** Altman wrote Sunday that the field must stay on "Team Humanity," warning that one country or one lab with too much power could produce "extremely dystopian" results.
* **Federal framework gets welcome:** He said OpenAI would welcome a federal framework of consistent frontier-AI safety rules and now writes explicit safety cases before reinforcement-learning runs expected to lift capabilities.
* **Confidential S-1, no 2026:** The ChatGPT-maker confidentially filed an S-1 in June. Altman told Fortune "we're not rushing into an IPO" and that a listing will not occur in 2026.
* **Independent evaluators get access:** He agreed with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on independent evaluators with employee-like access. "We will do the same. We'll have more to share soon," Altman wrote.

# [Dimon and Solomon star in Treasury's Trump praise tape](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Treasury on Monday night released a roughly one-minute G20 video of Jamie Dimon, David Solomon and other CEOs **[praising Trump-era deregulation, taxes, and U.S. manufacturing.](https://substack.com/redirect/7a0977e0-33f5-4cb1-a518-98cac87d5258?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
* **Barnacles on a boat:** Dimon said the U.S. has "been regulating nonstop for years like barnacles on a boat" and that deregulation can "free up capital, free up liquidity and make the system safer."
* **Asheville clips, Monday drop:** The interviews were taped at the G20 ministerial in Asheville, North Carolina, on Aug. 31 and Sept. 1. Treasury posted the package on its X account.
* **More CEOs on tape:** The video also features David Solomon, Eli Lilly CEO David Ricks, 3M CEO Bill Brown, and John Deere CTO Jahmy Hindman. Ricks cited U.S. plants "for the first time in over 40 years."
* **Scale of the chorus:** The featured firms employ about 550,000 people and generate about $376 billion in revenue. The White House cites $11.2 trillion in pledged U.S. investments.

# [Bitcoin slips as Clarity Act odds crash to 19%](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bitcoin fell to $76,890 and Cathie Wood's ARK sold crypto names Monday as Senate Clarity Act odds of **[passing this year dropped to 19%](https://substack.com/redirect/a9b62eaa-b86b-4f62-a71d-753f63af2beb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Polymarket ahead of Tuesday's vote.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Vote day, fading odds:** The Senate votes Tuesday afternoon on the Clarity Act. GOP senators made an 11th-hour push for Democratic votes, but Polymarket odds of 2026 passage fell to 19% from 31%.
* **Bitcoin gave back ground:** Bitcoin dropped 1.6% over 24 hours to $76,890, per CoinDesk data in the Barron's report. It is up 31% since the start of July and still down 12% in 2026.
* **Ether, XRP, stock proxies:** Ethereum slipped 1.9% to $2,475 and XRP edged 0.2% lower to $1.40. Coinbase was down 3.9% premarket after a 9% rally. Strategy fell 3.8% after gaining 4.6% Monday.
* **Wood lightened the sleeve:** ARK Invest sold shares Monday in CoinDesk owner Bullish, Coinbase, stablecoin issuer Circle Internet Group, and Ethereum treasury firm Bitmine Immersion Technologies.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

* **Next support is thin:** A close below 10,800 would leave little support until the 200-day moving average and the longer-term trend line, The Market Ear said, as software ripped and semis sold.

European semiconductor stocks were mixed Tuesday after a Monday selloff that **[Barron's tied to calls for a slowdown](https://substack.com/redirect/495756d0-aa45-4203-90da-207cbf86fd7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in advanced AI models over safety concerns.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40d26ce7-5fa8-4648-8b7f-adf1ca060f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Safety calls hit demand:** Barron's said those slowdown calls weighed on global chip stocks Monday as investors worried slower AI development could cut semiconductor demand.
* **Dutch equipment bid higher:** ASML Holding rose 0.4% and smaller rival ASM International gained 0.3%. BE Semiconductor Industries, a Dutch assembly-equipment supplier, was also up 0.4%.
* **Germany and STM slipped:** Infineon Technologies declined 0.6%. STMicroelectronics shares fell 0.7% as the European tape tried to stabilize after Monday's washout.
* **Monday 's fear was pace:** Investors treated weekend and Monday AI-safety warnings as a demand risk for chips, Barron's reported, leaving Tuesday's bounce uneven across the group.

I’m pretty sure Donald Trump doesn’t want you to know this, Peter: **Today is National Voter Registration Day.** This White House and its allies have gone out of their way to dissuade voters from participating in the midterms this fall — so we’d be surprised if they were celebrating today. They’ve attempted restrictions on voting by mail, made efforts to reduce registrations among new American citizens, and passed outrageous gerrymanders that take voting power away from people, particularly in communities of color. **So here’s one simple step to ruin Trump’s day: Remind your friends and family to check and update their voter registrations at[vote.org](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139254051/646758424/1193288156?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk4NWY5Mzc4LTJjYjEtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWYxZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qOMikA7yAVGB2rLo582VDsHK50JyXmYF1KGR9tomD0M=&emci=73dac996-1ab1-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&emdi=985f9378-2cb1-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&ceid=8431045).** And here’s one commitment I can make to you: the NDRC will continue fighting for every American’s right to be heard in their democracy. That means fighting for fair maps and fair representation. That means protecting voting rights. That means electing Democracy Defenders — we’ve endorsed over 200 for this November’s elections — to the specific state-level roles with the greatest ability to ensure fair redistricting and fair access to the ballot box. These elections don’t just matter this fall — we’ll feel the impacts of the outcomes for years to come. [**If you can, please power this work with a donation today. In Florida alone, the stakes could not be higher. A democratic socialist is running for Senate in President Trump's home state. A Republican-turned-Democrat is running to end 28 years of Republican governors. And national liberal organizations are pouring money into Congressional races that could chip away at the Republican House majority.

49 days is not much time. And [every dollar raised before midnight tonight goes towards fighting against Socialism.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f91c1ef449c042cdbc8d48399e54d0fb&_e=9pxS2pXbIK3TIOPtVDcUMmT4O7_sKr3BF_2chsqPlX2F5qpi3KRZoEvQIDYUKarMhkGjd8W2tofVutDw8Q2U3MFJ56C35GYiEHW7Fhd9tetlqGBPjj7aX4qgNuZqpussubuwda36_dJR-DlWjb2S5To6fUnabMkSUJUzSHkZwSKVVZ361K2AO9zCLq5FwIYBp7AQEAopImIZFkyfbG2uwg1DGSRrZTSIUFOk_xfKaOYFN6Yjq1bkpNTeDJ-0_SWbQscn5xZWt3SFrQxLP2cm8wQgxYj_kKrvjz3pf3WPo7hqCcwSHAZfYhB8kOufyHuN_mMklr02t8YihoAjiBMZQy8JLOx7bFVk6hq3gjFkGzrxAoSZyJ_RAqtjWvereQmTPPIl9Rq2Cfnn5yqn9VmOS9IsT3qNZRZVkTA6RkKm133tpvyQJnQwEyqOZZc3l_vtLnz-AMNtgwvlBUNivXrAmXivVnjtEG4IMKlYb4sfgai3SLUXZDL5jK0fCHXtyVQGBvGVhMx_jRQ21Qw-zuI6MRCVCqBIoNa56mdtXKLUJzSmSZRZe8GMWHAxkNA-qDMlnW48Q3KzPqNt92PGy9qsH6OrvRJ6pqvOGLEbBqrILbbcADKBDWR4Yg0IYP4YZK0Z3SN5yBz9sFwHQiNyY4SwyWMpL-X44vOBgxkz7m1Cxn0kIS3saMB8ulJLOusTRhWaK6kuUA1xcyhnRy9X3kEuO6S71gYzGqtWD4pBJwt6kSAVt2p_3xsRbgnIk4YnMJaSdaUj4nPnVMMq6PMa3pOpjg%3D%3D)

| **About the Republican Party of Florida**
* * *
The Republican Party of Florida will promote the principles upon which our nation and our state were founded: freedom, liberty, personal responsibility, and accountability.

We will advocate fiscally-sound, common-sense solutions that will promote job and economic growth, provide the best education to our children, and create a path to prosperity for Florida and America.

Members of the Republican Party of Florida will be united by these principles and will work to elect Floridians with integrity who will work to enact such solutions. We will seek to be the most effective state party in the nation and serve as a model for other party organizations.

| | Patriot,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **

_But now, Patriot, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning.

When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. _**We don 't have time to wait.**_**" **

And he was right.

The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers.

We may be in 13% of our schools now...

_But in the other 87%? _

The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them.

And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous."

You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it.

He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses.

And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now.

**Patriot, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- _this is it._ **

You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do.

But you can send them the tools to do it.

These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead.

All they're waiting on... is us.

**Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. **

You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back.

And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide. ✅ Florida ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee ✅ Oklahoma ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Arkansas ✅ Indiana And we're just getting started. Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country... That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom. That 's what Club America is about... Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. But now, Patriot, the question is... What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? Because here's the truth: These students aren't just signing up. They 're stepping up. They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous. But that isn't stopping them. They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever. They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, but brave. Not just loud, but principled. Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses. Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship. Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth. And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default. Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country. It's up to us to finish what he started. One chapter. One student. One school at a time. Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Patriot, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044
